run_distributed_speech_generation: run distributed speech generation using the VITS model with accelerate for multi-GPU inference
create_dataloader: create a dataloader that preprocesses text samples and batches them with proper padding for distributed inference
load_pokemon_data: load pokemon description text data from the svjack/pokemon-blip-captions-en-zh dataset with configurable split and max length
save_distributed_results: save generated audio waveforms to wav files with corresponding json metadata using a background thread pool
filter_existing_files: filter out already-processed items by checking existing wav files in the output directory
